LOCK_FISCAL_DEAD_ZONE plan + owner countersign required (NF525 frozen list).

master_gaps.title: KDS actor identity captured in transitions table but never exposed in drawer (anonymous bump)

master_gaps.title: KDS newbie confirmation manquante before PREPARED PATCH (fat-finger irreversible)
master_gaps.user_story: Stagiaire 1ere journee doigts gras, frole ecran tactile. Tap detected on kds-card__cta 52px×280px. Immediate PATCH PREPARED. OSS announces PRET. Audit_logs append-only NF525 = no silent rollback. Wave V removed 3s undo per owner mandate, leaving 0 net.
master_gaps.risk_if_absent: Newbie chef trains on real orders. Each error escalates.
master_gaps.implementation_hint: Option 1: user.kds_safety_mode flag (table users) — if true, double-tap required OR mini-dialog 'Pret? OUI/NON' 2s timeout auto-cancel. Option 2 universal: long-press 800ms only for PREPARING→PREPARED step. Option 3: training_mode KDS that logs no PATCH backend. Owner decision.

master_gaps.title: KDS help drawer / onboarding / training mode absent for newbie
master_gaps.user_story: Zero help/tutorial/guide/onboarding in 2768 LOC of KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue. No tooltip on actionable elements. Stagiaire day 1 sees grid 4×2 cards no idea what to do. Learning by trial-error on real orders.
master_gaps.risk_if_absent: Onboarding chef weekend/remplacant impossible without 2h walkthrough.
master_gaps.implementation_hint: KdsHelpDrawer (mirror KdsHistoryDrawer pattern) with 6-8 illustrated screens: card / timer / step ladder / shortcuts / allergie pill / cash-pending / recently-served / overflow. Trigger button '?' top-right.

master_gaps.title: KDS step ladder ACCEPT→PREPARING→PREPARED CTA label static 'Pret' for both taps

Newbie thinks 2nd tap is confirmation, not transition irreversible. Legacy 4-col layout had dynamic 'Demarrer' / 'Marquer Pret' labels per status — V2 regressed.
master_gaps.risk_if_absent: Source structurelle erreur newbie.
master_gaps.implementation_hint: Computed ctaLabel + ctaColor in KdsOrderCard: status=ACCEPT → 'Demarrer' orange, status=PREPARING → 'Marquer Pret' vert. 15 LOC. Mirror legacy convention.

master_gaps.title: KDS keyboard [A]-[H] no fat-finger/repeat protection
master_gaps.user_story: Stagiaire pose avant-bras sur clavier, 6 touches simultaneous. 6 PATCH PREPARED partent. 6 commandes announced PRET. Backend resilient (lockForUpdate idempotent) but UI/business effect real.
master_gaps.risk_if_absent: Cuisine rush physical keyboard friction.
master_gaps.implementation_hint: 5 LOC: e.repeat check + throttle 150ms between keydown handle. Combine. Inline-edit exception compatible.

master_gaps.title: Stock: 'il reste 3 portions' alert threshold (backend gated/log-only)

Backend support EXISTS (stock_levels.threshold_low + NotifyStockLowOnStockLevelChanged listener) BUT (a) flag FK_CATALOG_STOCK_LOW_ALERT_ENABLED=false default (b) StockLevelChanged dispatched ONLY on choice-boundary cross-zero (decrement 5→4→3 never triggers) (c) when fires, Log::warning only, no UI push.

Path B: add ChoiceBoundaryProximityEvent fired when on_hand <= threshold_low (not just on_hand=0). KDS subscribe + toast 'Reste 3 portions Frites' + son court.

master_gaps.title: Stock quick-toggle 'rupture du jour' from POS/KDS without admin nav
